system.description:
You take your water pistol technique and take it to its logical conclusion. You take both hands, and imitate the shape of a gun, before using the moisture in the air as an indicator from the location of creatures in range. You then rapidly fire, with extreme precision, against up to 8 creatures in range, each with a shot just as lethal than the last.

Make a ranged ninjutsu attack against up to 8 creatures in range, even if you cannot see them, once each. These attacks cannot be made at disadvantage. On a hit, you deal 10d6 piercing damage and 5d6 cold damage.

Hydrofication. These attacks are made with a +2 bonus to their critical threat range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6 for each damage type.
